title: 科學級 CMOS 成像系統~Scientific CMOS imaging systems
focus: 背照式 sCMOS 的像素物理、讀出雜訊、快門時序、EMVA 1288 校正與系統訊噪比預算~Pixel physics, read noise, shutter timing, EMVA 1288 calibration and system SNR budgets for back-illuminated sCMOS
summary: 從釘扎光電二極體與背照式結構出發，理解 sCMOS 為何能以 1 e⁻ 以下的讀出雜訊和 95% 的量子效率成像，再把滾動快門時序、光子轉移校正、DSNU/PRNU 校正與資料鏈路檢查整合成一套可驗收的科學相機工程紀錄。~Start from the pinned photodiode and back-illuminated structure to see why an sCMOS can image with sub-electron read noise and 95 percent quantum efficiency, then integrate rolling-shutter timing, photon-transfer calibration, DSNU/PRNU correction and data-link checks into an acceptable scientific-camera engineering record.

units.anchor: 背照式像素與釘扎光電二極體~Back-illuminated pixel and pinned photodiode
units.title: 光子到電子：量子效率與像素結構~Photons to electrons: quantum efficiency and pixel structure
units.mechanism: 科學級 CMOS（sCMOS）的每個像素都是一個釘扎光電二極體加上四到五個電晶體：轉移閘把累積的電子送到浮動擴散節點，重置電晶體清空節點，源極隨耦器把電荷轉成電壓，列選擇電晶體把訊號送上行匯流排。量子效率 QE 是入射光子被轉成可收集電子的比例；前照式像素的金屬連線與多晶矽閘會遮擋並反射光，即使加微透鏡也只有約 60% 到 80%，背照式把晶圓薄化、從背面入光，峰值 QE 可到 95%。6.5 µm 的像素尺寸是取樣解析度與全井容量之間的折衷。~Every pixel of a scientific CMOS sensor is a pinned photodiode with four or five transistors: a transfer gate moves the collected electrons to a floating-diffusion node, a reset transistor empties the node, a source follower converts charge to voltage, and a row-select transistor puts the signal on the column bus. Quantum efficiency is the fraction of incident photons converted to collectable electrons; in a front-illuminated pixel the metal wiring and polysilicon gates shade and reflect light, so even with microlenses QE stays near 60 to 80 percent, whereas back-illumination thins the wafer and admits light from the rear, pushing peak QE to about 95 percent. The 6.5 µm pixel pitch is a compromise between sampling resolution and full-well capacity.
units.model: 轉換增益 CG = q/C_FD。取浮動擴散電容 C_FD = 1.6 fF，CG = 1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C / 1.6×10⁻¹⁵ F = 100 µV/e⁻；全井 15,000 e⁻ 對應約 1.5 V 的節點電壓擺幅。若 100 個光子落在像素上，背照式（QE 0.95）得到 95 e⁻，前照式（QE 0.60）只有 60 e⁻。~Conversion gain is CG = q/C_FD. With a floating-diffusion capacitance C_FD = 1.6 fF, CG = 1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C / 1.6×10⁻¹⁵ F = 100 µV per electron, so a full well of 15,000 electrons corresponds to about 1.5 V of node swing. If 100 photons land on a pixel, a back-illuminated sensor with QE 0.95 yields 95 electrons while a front-illuminated one with QE 0.60 yields only 60.
units.verify: 用已校正的單色光源照射感測器，以 NIST 溯源的參考光電二極體量入射光子通量，把每像素平均電子數除以光子數得到各波長的 QE 曲線；再與廠商的光譜響應曲線比較，重點核對 400 nm 以下與 800 nm 以上兩端，因為背面鈍化與矽厚度的差異在這兩端最明顯。~Illuminate the sensor with a calibrated monochromatic source and measure the incident photon flux with a reference photodiode traceable to NIST; divide the mean electrons per pixel by the photon count at each wavelength to obtain the QE curve, then compare with the vendor spectral response, paying particular attention to the regions below 400 nm and above 800 nm where backside passivation and silicon thickness differ most.
units.failure: 背面鈍化不良時，表面態會俘獲短波長產生的電子，藍光與紫外 QE 大幅下降，且隨溫度與照射歷史漂移；影像看起來正常，但定量螢光比值會隨時間偏移。~Poor backside passivation lets surface states trap the electrons generated by short wavelengths, so blue and ultraviolet QE collapses and drifts with temperature and illumination history; images look normal but quantitative fluorescence ratios shift over time.
units.misconception: 只要像素越小，科學相機的靈敏度就越高。~Smaller pixels always make a scientific camera more sensitive.

units.anchor: 滾動快門時序圖~Rolling-shutter timing diagram
units.title: 滾動快門與全域快門的曝光幾何~Rolling versus global shutter exposure geometry
units.mechanism: sCMOS 的行級讀出電路一次只能處理一列，滾動快門因此讓每一列依序重置、曝光、讀出：每列曝光時間相同，但起始時刻相差一個列時間 t_line，整個畫面的首列與末列相差 N_rows×t_line。移動物體會被剪切變形，脈衝照明會在畫面上留下亮暗條帶。全域快門讓所有像素同時開始與結束曝光，但需要在像素內增加一個儲存節點與遮光結構，讀出雜訊通常高於滾動模式（例如 2.3 e⁻ 對 0.9 e⁻），填充因子也較低。許多 sCMOS 提供全域重置或光片讀出模式，用時序而非像素結構解決同時性問題。~Column readout circuits handle one row at a time, so a rolling shutter resets, exposes and reads rows in sequence: every row gets the same exposure, but its start is delayed by one line time t_line, and the first and last rows differ by N_rows×t_line. Moving objects shear and pulsed illumination leaves bright and dark bands across the frame. A global shutter starts and stops exposure for all pixels at once but needs an in-pixel storage node and light shield, so read noise is usually higher than in rolling mode (for example 2.3 versus 0.9 electrons) and the fill factor is lower. Many sCMOS cameras offer a global-reset or light-sheet readout mode that solves simultaneity with timing rather than pixel structure.
units.model: 畫面偏斜 = N_rows×t_line。取 2048 列、t_line = 10 µs，偏斜 = 20.48 ms。若曝光 t_exp = 30 ms，所有列同時開啟的窗口 = t_exp − 偏斜 = 9.52 ms，脈衝照明必須落在這 9.52 ms 內才不會產生條帶；若 t_exp 只有 5 ms，則不存在同時窗口，必須改用全域快門或全域重置。~Frame skew = N_rows×t_line. For 2048 rows and t_line = 10 µs the skew is 20.48 ms. With an exposure t_exp = 30 ms the window in which every row is open at once is t_exp − skew = 9.52 ms, so a light pulse must fall inside those 9.52 ms to avoid banding; with t_exp = 5 ms no common window exists and a global shutter or global-reset mode is required.
units.verify: 用一顆 LED 以 100 µs 的脈衝在曝光期間不同時刻閃爍，記錄哪些列被照亮，從亮帶的列數反推 t_line 與偏斜；再把閃爍時刻掃過整個曝光，確認同時開啟窗口的長度與計算值一致，並對照相機輸出的曝光結束觸發訊號。~Flash an LED for 100 µs at different moments during the exposure and record which rows are illuminated; from the number of bright rows deduce t_line and the skew, then sweep the flash across the whole exposure to confirm that the length of the common open window matches the calculation and lines up with the camera's exposure-end trigger output.
units.failure: 若用滾動快門拍攝旋轉或快速平移的目標，影像會出現剪切與形狀失真，後續的粒子追蹤或形變量測會得到系統性偏差，而且這種誤差無法用平場或暗場校正移除。~Imaging a rotating or fast-translating target with a rolling shutter shears the object and distorts its shape; downstream particle tracking or deformation measurement then carries a systematic bias that no dark or flat correction can remove.
units.misconception: 滾動快門代表畫面上每一列的曝光時間都不一樣。~A rolling shutter means each row receives a different exposure time.

units.anchor: 源極隨耦器與行級 ADC~Source follower and column ADC
units.title: 讀出鏈：相關雙取樣與雙增益 ADC~Readout chain: correlated double sampling and dual-gain ADCs
units.mechanism: 每一行都有自己的放大器與類比數位轉換器，數千個 ADC 平行工作，才能在低於 2 e⁻ 的讀出雜訊下達到每秒數十張全幅影像。重置浮動擴散節點時，開關的熱雜訊會在電容上留下隨機的 kTC 電荷，相關雙取樣先取樣重置電位、再取樣轉移後電位並相減，把這項雜訊消掉。剩下的讀出雜訊主要來自源極隨耦器的 1/f 與隨機電報雜訊，因此讀得越慢、取樣頻寬越窄，雜訊越低：同一顆相機在超靜音模式可達 0.7 e⁻，在快速模式約 1.6 e⁻。雙增益 ADC 同時以高增益與低增益數位化，再合成 16 位元輸出，兼顧低光靈敏度與全井動態範圍。~Each column has its own amplifier and analog-to-digital converter, and thousands of ADCs work in parallel, which is how full frames can be read at tens of frames per second with read noise below 2 electrons. Resetting the floating-diffusion node leaves a random kTC charge from switch thermal noise on the capacitance; correlated double sampling samples the reset level, then the post-transfer level, and subtracts them, cancelling that term. The remaining read noise comes mainly from 1/f and random-telegraph noise in the source follower, so slower readout with narrower sampling bandwidth gives lower noise: the same camera reaches 0.7 electrons in ultra-quiet mode and about 1.6 electrons in fast mode. Dual-gain ADCs digitize each pixel at high and low gain simultaneously and merge the results into a 16-bit output, preserving both low-light sensitivity and full-well dynamic range.
units.model: 重置雜訊 σ_kTC = √(kTC)/q。取 T = 300 K、C_FD = 1.6 fF：kTC = 1.38×10⁻²³×300×1.6×10⁻¹⁵ = 6.62×10⁻³⁶ C²，開根號得 2.57×10⁻¹⁸ C，除以 1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C 約為 16 e⁻ rms。沒有相關雙取樣時這 16 e⁻ 會主宰讀出雜訊；有 CDS 後殘餘雜訊降到約 1 e⁻。~Reset noise is σ_kTC = √(kTC)/q. With T = 300 K and C_FD = 1.6 fF, kTC = 1.38×10⁻²³×300×1.6×10⁻¹⁵ = 6.62×10⁻³⁶ C², whose square root is 2.57×10⁻¹⁸ C, or about 16 electrons rms after dividing by 1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C. Without correlated double sampling those 16 electrons would dominate the read noise; with CDS the residual falls to about 1 electron.
units.verify: 在完全遮光、最短曝光下連續拍 100 張，逐像素計算時間標準差並除以增益得到每像素的讀出雜訊分布；報告中位數與均方根兩個值，並分別在快速、標準與超靜音模式重複，確認雜訊隨讀出速度的趨勢與資料表一致，同時檢查直方圖尾端是否有隨機電報雜訊造成的高雜訊像素。~Capture 100 frames in complete darkness at the shortest exposure, compute the temporal standard deviation of each pixel and divide by the gain to obtain the per-pixel read-noise distribution; report both the median and the rms, repeat in fast, standard and ultra-quiet modes to confirm that noise falls with readout speed as the datasheet states, and inspect the histogram tail for high-noise pixels caused by random-telegraph noise.
units.failure: 雙增益合成點若校正不準，影像在合成訊號附近會出現一條明顯的非線性台階，光度量測在該強度區間出現 1% 到 2% 的系統誤差，且不同像素的台階位置不同。~If the dual-gain merge point is miscalibrated, the response shows a visible nonlinear step near the merge signal, photometry in that intensity range carries a 1 to 2 percent systematic error, and the step position differs from pixel to pixel.
units.misconception: 讀出雜訊是感測器的固定常數，與讀出速度無關。~Read noise is a fixed constant of the sensor, independent of readout speed.

units.anchor: 薄化晶圓與抗反射膜~Thinned wafer and anti-reflection coating
units.title: 背照式製程、矽厚度與冷卻封裝~Back-illuminated process, silicon thickness and cooled packaging
units.mechanism: 背照式感測器把完成電路的晶圓黏到載板上，從背面研磨與蝕刻到約 10 µm 的磊晶層，再以離子佈植與雷射退火做背面鈍化，形成把光生電子推向光電二極體的內建電場，最後鍍上針對可見光或近紅外最佳化的抗反射膜。矽的吸收長度隨波長快速增加，紅光與近紅外光子可能穿透整個薄矽層而不被吸收，因此矽越薄近紅外 QE 越低，但矽越厚電子橫向擴散造成的像素間串擾越大。感測器裝在充乾燥氣體或抽真空的封裝內，以熱電致冷器冷卻到 −8 °C 到 −45 °C，降低暗電流並避免結露。~A back-illuminated sensor is bonded face-down to a carrier wafer, ground and etched from the rear to an epitaxial layer about 10 µm thick, then passivated by ion implantation and laser annealing to create a built-in field that drives photoelectrons toward the photodiodes, and finally coated with an anti-reflection stack optimized for the visible or near infrared. The absorption length of silicon rises steeply with wavelength, so red and near-infrared photons can cross the thin silicon without being absorbed; thinner silicon lowers near-infrared QE, while thicker silicon increases pixel-to-pixel crosstalk from lateral electron diffusion. The sensor sits in a dry-gas or vacuum package cooled by a thermoelectric cooler to between −8 °C and −45 °C, which lowers dark current and prevents condensation.
units.model: 厚度 d 的矽層吸收比例為 1 − exp(−α·d)。取 d = 10 µm：700 nm 時 α ≈ 1.9×10³ cm⁻¹，α·d = 1.9，exp(−1.9) = 0.15，吸收比例 0.85；900 nm 時 α ≈ 306 cm⁻¹，α·d ≈ 0.31，exp(−0.31) = 0.73，吸收比例只有 0.27。這解釋了為何同一顆背照式感測器 700 nm 的 QE 可達 80% 以上，而 900 nm 掉到 30% 以下。~A silicon layer of thickness d absorbs the fraction 1 − exp(−α·d). With d = 10 µm: at 700 nm α ≈ 1.9×10³ cm⁻¹, α·d = 1.9, exp(−1.9) = 0.15 and 0.85 of the light is absorbed; at 900 nm α ≈ 306 cm⁻¹, α·d ≈ 0.31, exp(−0.31) = 0.73 and only 0.27 is absorbed. This is why the same back-illuminated sensor can exceed 80 percent QE at 700 nm yet fall below 30 percent at 900 nm.
units.verify: 以 850 nm 與 900 nm 的窄頻光源量 QE，與可見光 QE 比較，檢查近紅外衰減是否符合由矽厚度推算的吸收比例；再用針孔投影的點光源量測相鄰像素的訊號分攤比例（串擾），確認厚度的選擇在 QE 與串擾之間取得的平衡符合規格。~Measure QE with narrow-band sources at 850 nm and 900 nm and compare with the visible QE to check that the near-infrared roll-off matches the absorbed fraction predicted from the silicon thickness; then project a pinhole point source and measure how much signal spills into neighbouring pixels (crosstalk) to confirm that the chosen thickness balances QE and crosstalk as specified.
units.failure: 封裝漏氣或乾燥劑失效後，冷卻到 −20 °C 的感測器窗口內側會結霜，影像出現局部模糊與緩慢變化的暗斑，常被誤判為光學系統髒污；長期還會腐蝕打線。~After a package leak or desiccant failure, frost forms on the inner window of a sensor cooled to −20 °C, producing local blur and slowly changing dark patches that are often blamed on dirty optics; over time the moisture also corrodes the bond wires.
units.misconception: 矽層越厚，任何波長的量子效率都越高，沒有代價。~Thicker silicon raises quantum efficiency at every wavelength with no penalty.

units.title: 光子轉移法：增益、讀出雜訊與全井容量~Photon-transfer method: gain, read noise and full-well capacity
units.mechanism: 光子轉移法利用散粒雜訊的統計性質校正整條讀出鏈：電子數的變異數等於其平均值，所以在以數位單位（DN）量到的平均值與變異數之間，斜率就是增益 K（DN/e⁻）。做法是在均勻照明下對每個曝光時間拍兩張，取差影像的變異數除以 2 消除固定圖樣雜訊，對平均值作圖；零光點的截距給讀出雜訊，曲線在全井附近轉折並下降。這正是 EMVA 1288 標準規定的量測核心，所得的增益把後續所有雜訊都換算到電子單位。~The photon-transfer method calibrates the whole readout chain from the statistics of shot noise: the variance of the electron count equals its mean, so the slope of variance against mean, both measured in digital numbers, is the gain K in DN per electron. Under uniform illumination two frames are taken at each exposure time, the variance of their difference is halved to remove fixed-pattern noise, and it is plotted against the mean; the intercept at zero light gives the read noise and the curve bends over and falls near full well. This is the core measurement prescribed by the EMVA 1288 standard, and the resulting gain converts every later noise figure into electrons.
units.model: σ²_DN = K·μ_DN + σ²_read,DN。若平均值從 500 DN 增到 2500 DN 時變異數從 230 DN² 增到 1150 DN²，K = 920/2000 = 0.46 DN/e⁻，即每 DN 約 2.17 e⁻；暗幀變異數 0.30 DN² 的截距給 σ_read = 0.55 DN = 0.55/0.46 ≈ 1.2 e⁻。全井 15,000 e⁻ 對應 6,900 DN。~σ²_DN = K·μ_DN + σ²_read,DN. If the variance rises from 230 DN² to 1150 DN² while the mean rises from 500 DN to 2500 DN, then K = 920/2000 = 0.46 DN per electron, about 2.17 electrons per DN; the dark-frame variance intercept of 0.30 DN² gives σ_read = 0.55 DN = 0.55/0.46 ≈ 1.2 electrons, and a full well of 15,000 electrons corresponds to 6,900 DN.
units.verify: 用積分球或擴散板提供均勻度優於 1% 的照明，曝光時間以等比級數從暗到飽和取 20 個以上的點，每點兩張；在線性區以最小平方法擬合斜率與截距，把得到的讀出雜訊與前一單元的暗幀時間雜訊比較，並確認飽和轉折點換算的全井與資料表的 15,000 e⁻ 差異在 10% 以內。~Provide illumination uniform to better than 1 percent with an integrating sphere or diffuser, step the exposure geometrically from dark to saturation in at least 20 points with two frames each, fit slope and intercept by least squares in the linear region, compare the derived read noise with the dark-frame temporal noise from the previous unit, and check that the full well implied by the saturation knee agrees with the datasheet value of 15,000 electrons to within 10 percent.
units.failure: 照明不均或光源閃爍會使差影像的變異數偏大，擬合出的增益偏高、讀出雜訊偏低，後續以電子為單位的 SNR 模型全部樂觀；症狀是重複量測的增益值離散超過 5%。~Non-uniform or flickering illumination inflates the variance of the difference image, so the fitted gain is too high and the read noise too low, and every later SNR model in electrons becomes optimistic; the symptom is a gain value that scatters by more than 5 percent between repeated runs.
units.misconception: 感測器的增益可以直接從位元深度算出，不需要量測。~A sensor's gain can be derived from its bit depth without measurement.

units.anchor: 主暗幀與主平場~Master dark and master flat
units.title: 固定圖樣雜訊：DSNU、PRNU 與影像校正~Fixed-pattern noise: DSNU, PRNU and image correction
units.mechanism: sCMOS 每個像素與每一行都有自己的放大器和 ADC，所以偏移與增益在像素之間各不相同：暗訊號不均勻性 DSNU 是無光時各像素偏移的空間標準差，光響應不均勻性 PRNU 是均勻照明下各像素增益差異的相對標準差，行級 ADC 的差異則表現為縱向條紋。這些是固定圖樣，不會因取平均而減少，卻可以用校正移除：以多張暗幀平均成主暗幀扣除偏移與暗電流，以多張均勻照明影像平均成主平場除去增益差異。熱像素（暗電流特別高的像素）另以地圖標記並在分析時遮蔽。~Because every pixel and every column of an sCMOS has its own amplifier and ADC, offsets and gains differ from pixel to pixel: dark-signal non-uniformity (DSNU) is the spatial standard deviation of pixel offsets without light, photo-response non-uniformity (PRNU) is the relative spatial standard deviation of pixel gains under uniform illumination, and column-ADC differences appear as vertical stripes. These are fixed patterns that do not average down over time, but they can be corrected: many dark frames averaged into a master dark remove offset and dark current, and many uniform-illumination frames averaged into a master flat divide out gain differences. Hot pixels with unusually high dark current are mapped separately and masked during analysis.
units.model: 訊號 S = 10,000 e⁻ 時散粒雜訊 √S = 100 e⁻；若 PRNU = 0.5%，固定圖樣雜訊為 50 e⁻，總雜訊 √(100² + 50²) = 112 e⁻，SNR 從 100 降到 89。用 100 張平場平均後殘餘 PRNU 約 0.05%，即 5 e⁻，SNR 回到 99.9。暗電流 1.0 e⁻/px/s 在 −8 °C、曝光 10 s 時累積 10 e⁻，其散粒雜訊 3.2 e⁻ 已超過 1 e⁻ 的讀出雜訊。~At a signal S = 10,000 electrons the shot noise √S is 100 electrons; with PRNU = 0.5 percent the fixed-pattern term is 50 electrons, the total is √(100² + 50²) = 112 electrons and the SNR drops from 100 to 89. After dividing by a master flat averaged from 100 frames the residual PRNU is about 0.05 percent, or 5 electrons, and the SNR recovers to 99.9. A dark current of 1.0 electron per pixel per second at −8 °C accumulates 10 electrons in a 10 s exposure, whose shot noise of 3.2 electrons already exceeds a 1-electron read noise.
units.verify: 依 EMVA 1288 拍 100 張暗幀與 100 張約 50% 飽和的平場，各自平均後計算空間標準差：主暗幀的空間標準差（換算成電子）即 DSNU，主平場的相對空間標準差扣除殘餘時間雜訊後即 PRNU；再對校正後影像做行與列的平均剖面，確認縱向條紋的殘餘低於讀出雜訊。~Following EMVA 1288, record 100 dark frames and 100 flat frames at about 50 percent saturation, average each set and compute spatial standard deviations: the master dark's spatial deviation in electrons is the DSNU, and the master flat's relative spatial deviation, after removing residual temporal noise, is the PRNU; then take row and column mean profiles of a corrected image to confirm that residual vertical striping lies below the read noise.
units.failure: 若主平場是在與實驗不同的波長或光學配置下拍的，像素增益差異與鏡頭暈影都校正錯誤，結果是在影像上疊加一個低頻的假梯度與殘餘條紋，定量比值分析出現位置相關的偏差。~A master flat taken at a different wavelength or optical configuration from the experiment corrects both pixel gain and lens vignetting wrongly, imprinting a spurious low-frequency gradient and residual stripes on the image, so quantitative ratio analysis acquires a position-dependent bias.
units.misconception: 固定圖樣雜訊只要多拍幾張平均就會消失。~Fixed-pattern noise disappears if enough frames are averaged.

units.anchor: SNR 模型與取樣匹配表~SNR model and sampling-match table
units.title: 系統訊噪比、奈奎斯特取樣與光學匹配~System SNR, Nyquist sampling and optical matching
units.mechanism: 整合相機時要同時滿足兩件事：每個像素收到的電子數要讓 SNR 達標，而像素在樣品面上的等效尺寸要符合奈奎斯特取樣。SNR = S/√(S + D·t + σ_r²)，其中 S = QE·N_ph 是訊號電子數，D 是暗電流，σ_r 是讀出雜訊；低光時讀出雜訊主宰，所以 1 e⁻ 與 6 e⁻ 的差異決定能否看見訊號。取樣方面，物鏡的瑞利解析度 r = 0.61λ/NA，像素投影到樣品面的尺寸 p/M 必須不大於 r/2；放大率太低會欠取樣失去解析度，太高則把有限的光子攤到太多像素而降低每像素 SNR。~Integrating a camera means satisfying two things at once: each pixel must collect enough electrons for the required SNR, and the pixel's equivalent size at the sample must meet Nyquist sampling. SNR = S/√(S + D·t + σ_r²), where S = QE·N_ph is the signal in electrons, D the dark current and σ_r the read noise; at low light the read noise dominates, so the difference between 1 and 6 electrons decides whether a signal is visible at all. For sampling, the objective's Rayleigh resolution is r = 0.61λ/NA and the pixel projected onto the sample, p/M, must not exceed r/2; too little magnification undersamples and loses resolution, too much spreads the limited photons over too many pixels and lowers per-pixel SNR.
units.model: 取 S = 20 e⁻、D·t = 0.1 e⁻：σ_r = 1.0 e⁻ 時 SNR = 20/√(20 + 0.1 + 1) = 4.35；σ_r = 1.6 e⁻ 時 4.20；σ_r = 6 e⁻ 時 20/√56.1 = 2.67。取樣：λ = 520 nm、NA = 1.4 的物鏡 r = 0.61×520/1.4 = 227 nm，r/2 = 113 nm；6.5 µm 像素配 60× 時 p/M = 108 nm 剛好符合奈奎斯特，配 100× 則為 65 nm，過取樣 1.7 倍。~Take S = 20 electrons and D·t = 0.1 electron: with σ_r = 1.0 electron, SNR = 20/√(20 + 0.1 + 1) = 4.35; with σ_r = 1.6 it is 4.20; with σ_r = 6 it is 20/√56.1 = 2.67. For sampling, an objective with NA = 1.4 at λ = 520 nm has r = 0.61×520/1.4 = 227 nm and r/2 = 113 nm; a 6.5 µm pixel at 60× gives p/M = 108 nm, just meeting Nyquist, while 100× gives 65 nm, an oversampling of 1.7 times.
units.verify: 拍一片 USAF 1951 解析度靶或亞解析度螢光珠：由珠子影像的半高全寬反推系統點擴散函數，與 r 比較確認沒有欠取樣；再在已知光子通量下量測影像 SNR，與模型預測值比對，差異超過 20% 時回頭檢查 QE、增益或讀出模式的設定。~Image a USAF 1951 resolution target or sub-resolution fluorescent beads: derive the system point-spread function from the full width at half maximum of the bead images and compare with r to confirm there is no undersampling; then measure the image SNR at a known photon flux and compare with the model prediction, revisiting the QE, gain or readout-mode settings if the discrepancy exceeds 20 percent.
units.failure: 為了「提高解析度」把放大率從 100× 加到 150×，每像素光子數降到原來的 44%，低光影像的 SNR 從約 4.3 掉到約 2.8，訊號淹沒在讀出雜訊中，而解析度其實早已被物鏡的 NA 限制住。~Raising magnification from 100× to 150× in the hope of more resolution cuts photons per pixel to 44 percent of before, the low-light SNR falls from about 4.3 to about 2.8 and the signal sinks into read noise, while resolution was already capped by the objective's NA.
units.misconception: 放大率越高，影像解析度一定越好。~Higher magnification always gives better image resolution.

units.anchor: 驗收紀錄與資料鏈路~Acceptance record and data link
units.title: 相機驗收、觸發時序與資料鏈路交接~Camera acceptance, trigger timing and data-link handoff
units.mechanism: 驗收不只是核對資料表，而是把前面各單元的量測整理成一份可重現的紀錄：EMVA 1288 的增益、讀出雜訊、DSNU、PRNU、暗電流、線性度與動態範圍，附上量測時的冷卻溫度、讀出模式與韌體版本。時序方面要量觸發輸入到曝光開始的延遲與抖動，確認曝光結束訊號可用來同步光源或壓電台；資料鏈路方面要計算全幅、全速、16 位元的資料率是否在介面與儲存系統的能力之內，否則相機會丟幀而不報錯。交接時主暗幀、主平場、熱像素地圖與校正腳本必須隨相機一起交付。~Acceptance is more than checking a datasheet; it assembles the measurements from the earlier units into a reproducible record: EMVA 1288 gain, read noise, DSNU, PRNU, dark current, linearity and dynamic range, together with the cooling temperature, readout mode and firmware version in force at the time. On timing, measure the delay and jitter from trigger input to exposure start and confirm that the exposure-end output can synchronize light sources or a piezo stage; on the data link, compute whether the full-frame, full-speed, 16-bit data rate fits the interface and storage system, because a camera that cannot keep up drops frames silently. At handoff the master dark, master flat, hot-pixel map and correction scripts must travel with the camera.
units.model: 資料率 = 像素數×位元深度×幀率。2304×2304 = 5.31×10⁶ 像素，16 位元每幀 10.6 MB；89.1 fps 時為 946 MB/s ≈ 7.6 Gbit/s，超過 USB 3.0 實際約 350 MB/s 的能力，需要 CoaXPress 或把幀率限制到 31.6 fps（335 MB/s）。一小時連續擷取會產生 3.4 TB 資料。~Data rate = pixel count × bit depth × frame rate. 2304×2304 = 5.31×10⁶ pixels at 16 bits is 10.6 MB per frame; at 89.1 fps that is 946 MB/s, about 7.6 Gbit/s, beyond the roughly 350 MB/s that USB 3.0 delivers in practice, so CoaXPress is needed or the rate must be limited to 31.6 fps (335 MB/s). One hour of continuous capture produces 3.4 TB.
units.verify: 用脈衝產生器同時觸發相機與一台示波器，從相機的曝光輸出訊號量延遲與抖動（典型為微秒級）；以最高幀率連續擷取 10 分鐘，核對影像序號是否連續、時間戳間隔是否等於 1/幀率，並檢查儲存系統的寫入速度餘裕至少 20%。~Trigger the camera and an oscilloscope from the same pulse generator and measure delay and jitter on the camera's exposure output, typically microseconds; capture continuously at the maximum frame rate for 10 minutes, check that frame numbers are consecutive and timestamp intervals equal 1/frame rate, and verify that the storage system keeps at least 20 percent write-speed margin.
units.failure: 儲存速度不足時相機在高幀率下悄悄丟幀，時間序列分析把 25 ms 的間隔當成 12.5 ms，動態量測的速度全部高估一倍；若沒有序號核對，這個錯誤會一路傳到論文。~With insufficient storage speed the camera silently drops frames at high frame rate, time-series analysis treats a 25 ms gap as 12.5 ms and every dynamic velocity is overestimated by a factor of two; without frame-number checks the error propagates all the way into publication.
units.misconception: 相機資料表上的規格就是驗收標準，不需要自己量測。~Datasheet specifications are the acceptance criteria and need no in-house measurement.

example: 低光螢光成像的 SNR 預算練習：假設曝光 5 ms，每像素收到 50 個光子。背照式 sCMOS（QE 0.95、讀出雜訊 1.0 e⁻、暗電流 0.7 e⁻/px/s）：訊號 S = 47.5 e⁻，暗電荷 0.7×0.005 = 0.0035 e⁻ 可忽略，SNR = 47.5/√(47.5 + 0.0035 + 1.0²) = 47.5/6.96 = 6.8。前照式感測器（QE 0.60、讀出雜訊 1.6 e⁻）：S = 30 e⁻，SNR = 30/√(30 + 2.56) = 30/5.71 = 5.3。若實驗要求 SNR ≥ 20，背照式需要平均 (20/6.8)² ≈ 8.6，即 9 張；前照式需要 (20/5.3)² ≈ 14.2，即 15 張。再檢查快門：2304 列、列時間 10 µs 的偏斜為 23 ms，大於 5 ms 的曝光，所以不存在所有列同時曝光的窗口，脈衝照明必須改用全域重置模式或連續照明。數值為教學假設，不代表任何特定相機的規格。~SNR-budget exercise for low-light fluorescence: assume a 5 ms exposure with 50 photons per pixel. A back-illuminated sCMOS with QE 0.95, read noise 1.0 electron and dark current 0.7 electron per pixel per second gives S = 47.5 electrons, a negligible dark charge of 0.7×0.005 = 0.0035 electron, and SNR = 47.5/√(47.5 + 0.0035 + 1.0²) = 47.5/6.96 = 6.8. A front-illuminated sensor with QE 0.60 and read noise 1.6 electrons gives S = 30 electrons and SNR = 30/√(30 + 2.56) = 30/5.71 = 5.3. If the experiment needs SNR ≥ 20, the back-illuminated camera must average (20/6.8)² ≈ 8.6, so 9 frames, while the front-illuminated one needs (20/5.3)² ≈ 14.2, so 15 frames. Then check the shutter: 2304 rows at a 10 µs line time give a skew of 23 ms, longer than the 5 ms exposure, so no window exists in which all rows are exposed together and pulsed illumination must switch to a global-reset mode or continuous light. Values are teaching assumptions, not the specification of any particular camera.
history: CMOS 主動像素感測器由 NASA 噴射推進實驗室的 Eric Fossum 團隊在 1990 年代初發展，目標是取代功耗高、需要專用製程的 CCD；2009 年 Andor、Fairchild Imaging 與 PCO 共同發表第一代科學級 CMOS，以行級平行 ADC 與相關雙取樣達到約 1 e⁻ 的讀出雜訊與每秒 100 幀的全幅速度；2016 年前後背照式 sCMOS 把峰值量子效率推到 95%，2021 年量子型 CMOS（qCMOS）更把讀出雜訊降到 0.3 e⁻ 以下，使單一曝光能分辨光子數。本課只整理公開的物理與量測方法，不涉及任何廠商的製程細節。~CMOS active-pixel sensors were developed by Eric Fossum's group at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory in the early 1990s to replace power-hungry CCDs that needed a dedicated process; in 2009 Andor, Fairchild Imaging and PCO jointly introduced the first scientific CMOS, whose parallel column ADCs and correlated double sampling reached about 1 electron of read noise at 100 full frames per second; around 2016 back-illuminated sCMOS pushed peak quantum efficiency to 95 percent, and in 2021 quantitative CMOS (qCMOS) brought read noise below 0.3 electron, allowing photon numbers to be resolved in a single exposure. This course collects only public physics and measurement methods, not any vendor's process details.
